pitchblackdarkness.configuration.title: PBD - Pitch Black Darkness
pitchblackdarkness.configuration.darknes: 0 = vanilla, 3 = dark nights and black caves, 5 = absolute pitch black. Fractions like 0.5 keep a hint of visibility. Daylight is never touched. In game: /pbd <0-5>
pitchblackdarkness.configuration.moonMat: Full moon nights stay somewhat visible; new moon nights get the full darkness. If off, every night is as dark as a moonless one.
pitchblackdarkness.configuration.affectN: Apply darkness in the Nether too (cave axis only: no sky light down there).
pitchblackdarkness.configuration.affectE: Apply darkness in the End too (cave axis only: no sky light out there).
